name: Skills page, an agent's Skills tab, and a skill's Versions, Stats and Evals tabs
description: SPEC-02 read-only path: /skills renders the seeded skills with their agent count, a card opens the editor on the Config tab, and the Test Quality Reviewer's Skills tab shows its four enabled links out of the workspace's five seeded skills. Skill impact path: a Config save creates v2, Versions shows the v1 -> v2 diff and the Restore popup (Cancel only, so nothing is restored), Stats writes its window into ?window=7d, and Evals creates a pasted-diff case and gets a Quick estimate. This part writes a skill version and an eval case (hermetic DB) and never presses Start, so no model is called.
